@RHFilter.abs_F_of_mertens_prefix : ∀ {a A : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ A →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → |↑(RHFilter.pref n)| ≤ A * ↑n ^ a) → ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → |RHFilter.F x| ≤ 18 * A * (4 * x) ^ a
@RHFilter.abs_F_sqrt_eps_of_mertens : ∀ {ε A : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    0 ≤ A →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → |↑(RHFilter.pref n)| ≤ A * ↑n ^ (1 / 2 + ε)) →
        ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → |RHFilter.F x| ≤ 18 * A * 4 ^ (1 / 2 + ε) * x ^ (1 / 2 + ε)
'RHFilter.abs_F_of_mertens_prefix' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'RHFilter.abs_F_sqrt_eps_of_mertens' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
